displayDescription: A wooden marionette lifts a glowing idea; yarn threads connect miniature houses that stand up and light on a night-blue stage.
styleRenderer: Three.js 0.186 WebGLRenderer (procedural miniature stage, MeshStandardMaterial, PCF soft shadows, ACES tone mapping)
Canvas 2D procedural textures (painted cyclorama, oak planks, maple grain)
motionEngine: GSAP 3.15 paused timeline at window.__timelines.video (drives composition time and heading opacity)
Nested paused GSAP pose timeline sampled at quantized 15 fps exposures (held poses on twos); single owner per pose property
limitations: Digital marionette rig rendered with Three.js, not photographed physical puppets; held poses on twos approximate stop-motion posing.
Materials (maple, walnut, velvet, painted backdrop, painted-wood houses, wool yarn) are procedural shading approximations with no photographic lens grain or depth of field.
Blender was not used, per user instruction.

STYLE.json lists no preview_recipes and BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json has no matched sources or contact sheets, so no source-frame observations were applied; the night cyclorama palette is a scene-chosen alternative to the earlier cream swatch.
Rendering and browser QA not run by the agent.
